text: Starting the going-home work on the evening round is the solution the other four lean on.
bullets: It uses hours you already have. The decision is made at night, and today nothing moves until the morning signature.
It asks almost nothing new of your doctors. They already sign an early summary in the evening for cash patients.
It works less well where evening decisions come late. That is the open point to settle, and the trial starts there.
chat.pointer: Open any support to see what sits under it.
chat.invite: Next is who has to agree for all five to work. Shall we go there?
chat.note: The decision is already made at night. Only the work waits.
prompts: Our doctors don’t use voice notes
What would the insurance desk need?

blocks.title: Start the work the night before
blocks.deck: Five things this solution depends on. Three are settled by what you told us; two are still open.

blocks.solution: Start the going-home work on the evening round

lenses.finding: No new staff and no new system for a two-week trial
more_points: Doctors keep the round they already do
Nurses move the same work earlier
Nothing to buy for a trial on one ward

lenses.finding: Doctors already sign an early summary at night for cash patients
more_points: Doctors decide on the round, as today
Nurses start the discharge checklist that night
Billing draws up the bill before morning

lenses.finding: Works on paper at first. The software link comes later.
more_points: The summary is drafted from the day’s notes
The bill stays up to date
The trial does not wait for it

lenses.finding: Families hear the night before, so transport is booked in time
more_points: A call or message the same evening
What to bring and whom to see

lenses.finding: Decisions come any time from 6 to 9 PM, so some night work starts late
more_points: A consultant deciding at 6 PM leaves three hours to act
A consultant deciding at 9 PM leaves almost none
The trial should start with the late deciders

blocks.condition: Other hospitals saved 6 to 8 hours a discharge this way. Not yet measured here.
